newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EUROPAY TO HOLD ELECTRONIC BANKING SEMINAR.
newsitem.headline: EUROPAY TO HOLD ELECTRONIC BANKING SEMINAR.

text.p: Lithuania's Savings Bank said on Tuesday that Europay International has organised a seminar for Lithuanian banks on Wednesday on the prospects of developing the country's electronic payments market.
The bank said in a statement that the representatives of Europay International will focus on electronic trade, its expanding market and the security measures for issuing credit cards.
The bank also said that the seminar will be attended by Lithuania's Agricultural Bank, Snoras Bank, the State Commercial Bank and Savings Bank.
Savings Bank was the the first Lithuanian bank to join Europay International in 1991 and to issue and serve Eurocard/Mastercard cards in Lithuania.
